about: MoE prefill mods. Written on llama.cpp master 7592b61d3 (2026-11-10) before this repo's rules: most have no check mode, two are ON by default, one has no switch; each row records its rule exceptions. Every patch here also applies alone on b12359 / v1.0.0 (git apply --check, 2026-11-15; BoltBeam tests/test_engine_patches.py). Series order = list order; the six apply together in this order. budget = measured size. Gains are against this engine's stock build or the same build with the switch off.

mods.name: moe-prefill
mods.title: MoE routing sort, MMQ tile knob, pinned staging
mods.switch_null_why: default ON, three knobs; stock needs GGML_CUDA_BATCH_GET_STAGING=0 and GGML_CUDA_MMID_PAR_MIN larger than any batch (read from the patch code)

evidence.numbers: test-backend-ops -o MUL_MAT_ID 967/967 (helper forced, and GGML_CUDA_MMQ_ID_J=128 forced); greedy temp 0, 4 prompts (397-6,311 tokens) and a checkpoint save + restore test: text and top-5 logprobs bitwise identical to the stock build, default --cache-ram and --cache-ram 0

match.what: greedy temp-0 prompts (397-6,311 tokens): text and top-5 logprobs vs the stock build

gain.conditions: RTX 5090 (PCIe), Ryzen 7 5800X, 31 GB RAM, one request at a time; a MoE GGUF on the engine's qwen4exp graph (IQ1_M), -t 8 -b 4096, cold unique-nonce real-text chat prompts, medians of 3 reps x 2 alternating passes; model fully in VRAM, -ub 2048, default --cache-ram; decode 128 tokens 128.3 vs stock 128.9 (unchanged)

mods.exercised_by: MUL_MAT_ID (MoE expert matmul) prefill on CUDA; measured on one MoE model
limits: GGML_CUDA_MMQ_ID_J (tile width) is a sweep knob, off by default; wider tiles were refuted (expert MMQ 354 -> 395 ms at J=128)
the staging buffer holds pinned host memory equal to the largest staged span (448 MiB with the RAM prompt cache, 128 MiB with --cache-ram 0)

archived.name: ple-pipeline
archived.written_on: 7592b61d3 with 05-ple-prefetch-async applied first (both edit src/models/qwen4exp.cpp); it applies there
archived.why: Opt-in per-layer-embedding pipeline: raw IQ4_NL rows copied on host threads, dequantized on the GPU. Bitwise identical (4 prompts, restore test, tensor sums, test-backend-ops GET_ROWS 216/216). Gain at -ncmoe 12: 10k 5,888 -> 6,012 (one outlier rep), 2.7k no gain (5,198 -> 4,923), with 2.3x the major faults. Decommissioned 2026-11-14: it did not apply to the llama.cpp pin b12359 (v1.0.0).
